metadata.purpose: Switch to the latest accumulator-produced Observable, updating the accumulator from each delivered inner value.

conditions: Each source value cancels the preceding inner before selecting its replacement.
The callback sees the latest inner output as its accumulator, not the previous callback result.
Stale cancelled inner notifications are illegal; successful outer completion waits for current inner completion.

scope.parameters: Opaque explicit seed, valid Observable-returning indexed accumulator and one active inner.
scope.callbacks: One correlated indexed invocation carries {accumulator,value}; latest delivered inner.next overwrites accumulator.
scope.time: No clock or scheduler is created. Outer and inner sources supply time; same-time delivery order is explicit in the input sequence.
scope.reentrancy: Non-reentrant reactions with synchronous projection outcomes. Exact teardown traces assume source initialization has returned before terminal events.
exclusions: Promise/Iterable conversion, undefined/invalid inner and synchronous reentrant projection.
Deprecated inner result-selector mechanics outside the inspected switchScan implementation.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Acquire one outer subscription; no projection or inner subscription before an accepted outer value.

ownership.sharing: No sharing or replay introduced. Each result subscription owns its counter, active-inner bindings and queue; an inner producer may itself be shared.
ownership.reset: Latest accumulator starts at seed on every new downstream subscription; cancelled inner cannot update state.

resources.owner: this result subscription; generation is its admission index
external projection binding; generation correlates the invocation

dispatch.actionSemantics: Commit next state, then interpret the ordered actions. A return is resolved before the next external input. Never replace RxJS delivery with an implicit event FIFO.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between fully resolved reactions; release the outer if still open and all active inners; discard queued values without completing.
Outer completion is not cancellation of admitted or queued inner work.

inputs.description: the outer source delivers a value

controls.description: outer open; active inners and queue are explicit stored data
one unresolved synchronous projection, with a reserved concurrency slot
outer completed; wait for admitted/queued work
completed, errored or cancelled; owns no live subscriptions

rules.nextState: outer open with index zero and no active inners or queued values
rules.explanation: State supplied at admission is the last delivered inner value, initially the seed. Subscription connects to the outer source. Pipeline construction alone starts no projection or inner execution.

rules.guard: a concurrency slot is available and the index can advance
actions: request one projection with the input and admission index
rules.nextState: one pending projection; index advanced once
rules.explanation: State supplied at admission is the last delivered inner value, initially the seed. An accepted outer value invokes the projection once with that value and the next zero-based admission index. The returned inner source is subscribed only after projection succeeds.

rules.guard: an inner is active and the index can advance
rules.nextState: previous inner removed before the new projection
rules.explanation: State supplied at admission is the last delivered inner value, initially the seed. When another outer value arrives, unsubscribe the current inner before invoking the new projection. Only the replacement inner may subsequently contribute values; cancellation does not undo previously delivered values.

actions: subscribe the returned source under the pending invocation generation
rules.nextState: new inner admitted; no outer value emitted directly
rules.explanation: State supplied at admission is the last delivered inner value, initially the seed. A successful projection starts its inner subscription. The outer input itself is not forwarded; values come from the admitted inner.

actions: error downstream with the thrown value
release the open outer and every remaining inner; discard the queue
rules.explanation: State supplied at admission is the last delivered inner value, initially the seed. If projection throws, forward that error and tear down all owned subscriptions. Queued values are discarded without projection, and no completion follows.

rules.guard: the notification belongs to an active inner generation
rules.nextState: retain the same active set and queue
rules.explanation: State supplied at admission is the last delivered inner value, initially the seed. Values from admitted active inners are forwarded unchanged in actual delivery order.

rules.guard: the error belongs to an active inner generation
actions: release all owned subscriptions and discard queued values
rules.explanation: State supplied at admission is the last delivered inner value, initially the seed. An active inner error ends the whole result, including the outer subscription and other active inners.

actions: release the open outer and active inners; discard the queue without notifying downstream
rules.explanation: State supplied at admission is the last delivered inner value, initially the seed. Downstream cancellation unsubscribes from the outer and every active inner. It neither completes the result nor projects queued values.

rules.nextState: remove that inner and keep waiting
rules.explanation: State supplied at admission is the last delivered inner value, initially the seed. An inner completing does not complete the result while the outer is still open. Wait for more outer values or other active inners.

rules.guard: the notification belongs to an active inner generation
rules.nextState: retain the same active set and queue
rules.explanation: State supplied at admission is the last delivered inner value, initially the seed. After the outer completes, values from remaining inners continue to flow until those inners finish.

rules.guard: the error belongs to an active inner generation
actions: release all owned subscriptions and discard queued values
rules.explanation: State supplied at admission is the last delivered inner value, initially the seed. An inner error while draining still ends the result immediately; other inner work and any queued values are discarded.

actions: release the open outer and active inners; discard the queue without notifying downstream
rules.explanation: State supplied at admission is the last delivered inner value, initially the seed. Cancellation while draining releases the remaining inners and discards queued work without completion.

rules.guard: matching final inner and empty queue
rules.explanation: State supplied at admission is the last delivered inner value, initially the seed. The result completes only when the outer has completed and all admitted inner work, including any queue, is finished. The final cleanup order follows this operator family under the post-setup profile.

rules.nextState: outer done; preserve active inners and queued values
rules.explanation: State supplied at admission is the last delivered inner value, initially the seed. Outer completion stops new arrivals but does not cancel the current inner work. Keep forwarding inner values and, where applicable, draining the queue.

rules.guard: no active inner and empty queue
rules.explanation: State supplied at admission is the last delivered inner value, initially the seed. If the outer completes with no inner work left, complete immediately and release the outer subscription.

actions: release the outer and active inners; discard the queue
rules.explanation: State supplied at admission is the last delivered inner value, initially the seed. An outer error is forwarded immediately. Unlike completion, it cancels active inners and discards queued values.
